name: Participant object states
description: Describes an entity's state at different points in time while the identity of the entity remains, using temporally qualified continuants. The example tracks a microstructure quality (segregation factor) before and after annealing.
competency_questions: What was the state of this object before and after the process? Which temporally qualified continuant is a state of which material entity? At which time does a given state exist, and which quality did the entity bear then?
